pointsToRemember: Take a great serving of gourd vegetables in your curry those are enriched with soluble fibre and good water content too.
Use olive oil in salad dressing.
Avoid dairy products (milk, curd and paneer) or mixing fruit with dairy products (smoothies, pudding, custard etc).
Restricting non-vegetarian foods will reduce digestive load so the body can focus on eliminating toxins rather than breaking down complex proteins and fats.
Avoid all preserved/packaged/processed foods or foods with artificial colours/additives/flavours.
Use iodized salt (3g for one individual) for cooking as iodine is very important for the thyroid gland.
Be regular with foot massages before going to bed.
Digestive powder (roast and blend jeera, ajwain and fennel seeds powder together in fine powder).
Minimum try to cover 2.5 L/day of water intake.
sleepRoutine: Finish your dinner 2 hours before bed time and keep it subtle on the gut (less spicy and less oily).
Get rid of electronic devices 1 hour before bedtime.
Take a shower and do a warm oil massage to the soles of your feet.
It will be slightly time consuming to fall asleep, consistency is the key to correct your natural body clock.
yogaClass: Take a small meal 30 mins before the class.
Do not go empty stomach as you will feel exhausted.
Fix the timing and join the same session as far as possible to help with a set routine.
Try to give intervals between every 2-3 hours, avoid long sitting hours. You can make a habit of stretching your body.
